milestoneTitle: CLI Tool + Tier 1 Benchmark Refactoring for JSON-lines Output
milestoneDescription: Build the gpubench CLI tool (scripts/gpubench, single-file Python, stdlib+sqlite3 only) implementing list, compile, run, info, validate commands per docs/cli_design.md. Refactor all 12 Tier 1 benchmarks (.hip and _metal.mm files) to: (1) read BENCH_PARAM_* environment variables for all parameters defined in their params.json, (2) output JSON-lines protocol to stdout (kernel events with name/time_ms/params + summary event per docs/output_protocol.md), (3) send human-readable output to stderr only. The CLI must create SQLite database per docs/schema.sql, auto-detect platform, sweep scaling parameter values with configurable repetitions (default 7). End-to-end test: gpubench run --tier 1 --reps 1 should produce a valid SQLite database. See issue #167 for details.
verificationFeedback:
Two Tier 1 benchmarks have enum mismatch bugs causing 0 kernels to run when non-default enum values are passed:

1. atomic_operations (.hip + _metal.mm): params.json enum values are 'atomicAdd','atomicCAS','atomicMin' but code strcmp compares against 'add','cas','min'. Fix: change code to compare against params.json values (atomicAdd/atomicCAS/atomicMin) in both files.

2. warp_shuffle (.hip + _metal.mm): params.json enum values are 'shfl_xor','shfl','shfl_up','shfl_down' but code strcmp compares against 'xor','basic','up','down'. Fix: change code to compare against params.json values (shfl_xor/shfl/shfl_up/shfl_down) in both files.

All other checks pass: CLI tool works correctly, schema matches, Group A benchmarks (6) all pass, Group B other 4 benchmarks pass. Only these 4 files need fixing.
